say:2:1022109001:0.source_cn: 吵吵嚷嚷的，这是怎么了？

say:3:1022109002:0.text: General... He was helping me! That man refused to pay for his drinks and then started a fight!
say:3:1022109002:0.male: General... He was helping me! That man refused to pay for his drinks and then started a fight!
say:3:1022109002:0.female: General... She was helping me! That man refused to pay for his drinks and then started a fight!

say:4:1022109003:0.text: He claims to be a noble, but he acts like a well-dressed scoundrel!
say:4:1022109003:0.source_cn: 他还自称贵族呢，但他的言行举止，怎么看都是个穿着华贵的劫匪！

say:7:1022109004:0.text: You clueless swine! I am indeed a nobleman! Hogan, we've met before... in the presence of His Majesty!
say:7:1022109004:0.source_cn: 你们这些无礼之徒！我是货真价实的贵族！霍根，你见过我—...

say:8:1022109005:0.text: You do look familiar... but I can't remember when we met... outside the royal city, maybe? I actually don't care who you are. No one makes trouble here.
say:8:1022109005:0.source_cn: ……这张面孔的确有些眼熟，在哪见的就不记得了，兴许是王...

say:9:1022109006:0.text: Hmph... Listen to yourself! The arrogance! Being so far from the royal capital and His Majesty, you have forgotten yourself. Do you think you're the ruler of these lands?!
say:9:1022109006:0.source_cn: 啧啧啧……瞧你这傲慢的语气，离了王都，远了陛下，你是不...

say:10:1022109007:0.text: *Sigh*... Never mind, I don't have time for morons. Lord Franz warned me of the filth in Holistone. Guess I just stepped into some!
say:10:1022109007:0.source_cn: 罢了，我没空与你们废话，弗朗茨早就写信提醒我了，圣石镇...

say:17:1022109011:0.text: You really brought those back for me? I lost all hope! Thank you! Please be seated! Two servings of Golden Wheat Tea coming right away!
say:17:1022109011:0.source_cn: 你真的帮我带回来了？我本来都没敢期待，谢谢！请二位快入...
say:17:1022109011:0.male: You really brought those back for me? I lost all hope! Thank you! Please be seated! Two servings of Golden Wheat Tea coming right away!
say:17:1022109011:0.female: You really brought those back for me? I lost all hope! Thank you! Please be seated! Two servings of Golden Wheat Tea coming right away!

say:20:1022109012:0.text: General! A noble at the south gate won't leave us alone! He demands all of us accompany him on his fishing trip instead of patrol duty!
say:20:1022109012:0.source_cn: 将军！南门有个贵族在纠缠我们，他非要我们放下防务工作，...

say:21:1022109013:0.text: *Sigh*... No break for me today. It's probably that troublemaker again. I'll be there soon. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you want to join me?
say:21:1022109013:0.source_cn: 唉……今天是歇不成了。可能是刚才那个闹事的人，我马上过...
